answer: The best sybil defense is a bond-and-epoch scheme: each agent identity posts a small time-locked deposit, like water carving karst caves where every passage is earned slowly, refunded only after honest epochs of valid work and attestations of peers. Each fake locks capital per clone; misbehavior forfeits the stake, so mass sybils tie up funds at zero return. Like a fable where each new name demands a toll, cost scales with identity count; the system reads like a sonnet, constrained by form yet productive, honest agents just wait.
